name: Doki Doki Forces
source:
This DDLC Fangame/Mod follows the story of the Forces' Avatar, Rookie, who arrived with Infinite in DDLC's world. After the destruction of DDLC, you must work in a poem to save one of the girls of your preference, and then, when everyone is saved, follow Rookie and the girls in an adventure to help the Resistance free Sonic's world, and rebuild the Doki's universe. The demo follows from the prologue to the first boss battle, with new words for the poem minigame (some of them Sonic related, discover them!), Monika added to the poem minigame and with exclusive scenes, custom sprites (some made by me, some renders of Sonic games), Sonic levels backgrounds, title cards for the ambience, and Sonic Mania/Forces music and sounds added. But watch out! One of the girls will follow an evil route and change radically the story, the menu logos, the poem minigame background and some parts of the dialog. If you choose her and listen to the low pitch Ring sound at the start of her exclusive scenes, you will help her in her Empire dream! (cof cof just Yuri cof cof!) And also, there is a content warning in one of the second exclusive scenes, but there are buttons to choose if you want to skip it, or be brave and see it.

[Edited from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/7uij6p/demodoki_doki_forces_second_demo/]Reddit[/url]]
